data.title: Which casino operator will win F1 weekend in Las Vegas?
data.description:
The Las Vegas Grand Prix is taking over the Las Vegas Strip this weekend. While the Formula One race creates traffic issues and pedestrian congestion, it is also one of the biggest Strip hotel pricing weekends of the year and attracts international baccarat players. Those are positive developments considering the weekend before Thanksgiving was traditionally one of the slowest periods on the Las Vegas calendar before it was transformed into a high-margin luxury event, injecting over $900M to $1.5B annually into the regional economy.

Analysts have Wynn Resorts (WYNN) circled as the best positioned casino operator to take advantage of the Grand Prix weekend, while MGM Resorts (MGM) is also expected to benefit and Caesars Entertainment (CZR) is seen as facing a more uneven picture. 

A survey by Truist of hotel room rates for November indicated Wynn (WYNN) properties were up 29%, driven higher by VIP guests packaged tied to the Grand Prix weekend. The Truist survey showed MGM's (MGM) room rates are also higher for November rates, while the room rates at Caesars properties (CZR) are notably lower on average due in part to a lower mix of affluent guests. Of note, Caesars (CZR) has eight properties along the track, while MGM's (MGM) Bellagio and Cosmopolitan sit on the course. 

The primary stock directly tied to Formula One racing is the Formula One Group tracking stock, issued by its parent company Liberty Media Corporation and traded on the Nasdaq under the tickers (FWONK) and (FWONA).

data.title: Prospect Capital exits Security Fire Systems with 41.8% realized IRR
data.description:
Prospect Capital (PSEC) achieved a 41.8% realized gross annualized internal rate of return from the completion of the exit of its senior secured first lien term loan and preferred equity investment from Security Fire Systems, it said Friday.

The business development company received cash exit proceeds of ~$25M for its investment in SFS. The exit achieved a 1.2x multiple of invested capital through a combination of interest income, prepayment fees, equity distributions, and other cash flows.

"Our realization of this investment demonstrates our ability to generate attractive risk-adjusted returns by investing in the lower middle market," said Angel Solis, managing director at Prospect (PSEC).

Prospect Capital (PSCC) stock rose 0.8% in premarket trading.

SFS offers a broad line of fire security and protection products and services, including  automatic fire sprinkler design services, fire sprinkler system installation, system testing, system maintenance and servicing, remodel & retrofits, fire alarms, and emergency response.

Anthropic and SpaceX prove Nasdaq is crushing the IPO game
data.description:
The trajectory for the Anthropic (ANT) IPO is still up for discussion, but there is one clear winner that has been above the debate. The Nasdaq (NDAQ) has walked away from the notable debut with a swagger after snatching the biggest listing of all time. Less than six months ago, the stock exchange scored another record IPO, wooing SpaceX (SPCX) to its market.

Bigger picture: It's been a bumper year for the Nasdaq (NDAQ), which has outpaced its main rival by a 10x spread. According to Dealogic, there have been 64 Nasdaq IPOs this year that have raised $201.8B, compared to the $20.8B total raised from 42 IPOs on the New York Stock Exchange. Shareholders have been happy with the performance, with Nasdaq (NDAQ) shares climbing 21% over the past year, and 92% over the last three years, nearly double the returns of NYSE-parent Intercontinental Exchange (ICE). 

"Anthropic's IPO is a very proud moment for us," Nasdaq (NDAQ) CEO Adena Friedman told Reuters. "We've been engaging with the Anthropic team for a very long time. Separate from the entire listing experience, we've been a client to them, as we are to the AI ecosystem, and so we also have gotten to know them in that context as well."

What's the difference? Besides the emphasis on courtship, especially to Silicon Valley and high-growth disruptors, the Nasdaq's (NDAQ) ecosystem provides some structural advantages. Those include significantly lower listing fees, more flexible entry requirements, and generally faster IPO processing. A Nasdaq (NDAQ) listing also offers access to popular benchmarks like the Nasdaq-100 (NDX), and the exchange has even loosened its rules to fast-track names like SpaceX (SPCX) to boost liquidity and broaden the overall shareholder base.

data.title: VisionWave shares jump ~24% on deal for critical minerals intelligence platform
data.description:
• VisionWave Holdings (VWAV) Friday reported the acquisition of the Critical Minerals Intelligence Platform (CMIP), sending shares up ~24% in early trading. VisionWave intends to pursue near-term revenue opportunities through subscription-based intelligence services, compliance documentation, and transaction-related services
  • The agreement with Litial Ltd was signed on November 18, 2026, and the acquisition has not yet closed, the company said.
  • If completed, the acquisition would mark VisionWave's entry into the defense-industrial supply chain intelligence market and is intended to establish a new commercial technology offering with the potential to generate recurring revenue through subscriptions, compliance-related services, and transaction-based fees.
  • The platform initially focuses on tungsten and antimony, two materials of strategic importance to defense, aerospace, and advanced manufacturing. VisionWave also sees the potential to extend the platform to other critical minerals, specialized industrial materials, and defense-related components.

data.title: JBS establishes a new multiprotein platform in Oman
data.description:
JBS N.V. (JBS) announced it established a new multiprotein production platform in Oman that covers beef, poultry, and lamb.

The company holds an 80% stake in a newly established food holding entity that consolidates two production assets in Oman, while Oman Food Capital holds the remaining 20% stake. Oman Food Capital is the food and agribusiness investment arm of the Oman Investment Authority. 

The joint venture is expected to contribute to strengthening food security in Oman, in line with the Sultanate’s Vision 2040, while positioning the country as a strategic platform for the production of halal food products for export to multiple markets. The initiative is designed to serve the global halal market, which currently encompasses an estimated 2B consumers worldwide. With the investments, the operation is expected to reach an estimated static industrial production capacity of approximately 300K tons per year. That capacity corresponds to the daily processing of approximately 1K head of cattle, 5K lambs, and 600K chickens.

On a broader scale, JBS (JBS) noted that the initiative reinforces its strategy of diversification by geography and protein and proximity to key consumer markets.

Shares of JBS (JBS) are down 9.6% over the last month. The dividend yield for new buyers of the stock is 8.4%.
